verdict.rationale: Cua includes agent-facing pieces (cua-agent, named agents), so consuming external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. The only MCP evidence, though, is server-side: Cua Driver is exposed through MCP so that external agents like Claude Code, Codex and Cursor can use it. That is the opposite direction and earns no credit here. Nothing in the pack shows Cua can register third-party MCP servers and call their tools.
